sentences.en: His affected manner of speaking seemed very absurd to me.
sentences.zh: 他装腔作势的说话方式在我看来非常荒谬。

sentences.en: This is the most absurd thing I have ever heard.
sentences.zh: 这是我听过的最荒谬的事情。

sentences.en: Bathing in the Ganges won't grant you nirvana, that's absurd.
sentences.zh: 在恒河沐浴并不能让你得到涅槃，这真是荒谬的想法。

senses.zh: 愚蠢的，荒谬的；滑稽可笑的；荒诞派的

mnemonic: ab（离开）+surd（合理的）→不合理的→荒谬的
